timeline.title: Research Intern (Master's Thesis)
timeline.company: School of Computing, National University of Singapore
timeline.summary: Focus: XGBoost-based variational flow matching for mixed-type tabular generation.
highlights: Designed an XGBoost-based variational flow-matching framework for mixed-type tabular generation, using regression heads for numerical features and multiclass classification heads for categorical features.
Implemented and benchmarked the Python pipeline against 12 neural and tree-based baselines on nine public datasets.
Achieved the best overall average rank among 13 generators while balancing fidelity, downstream utility, and empirical privacy risk.

timeline.title: Research Scientist Intern
timeline.summary: Reasoning-augmented product search for conversational shopping.
highlights: Built a reasoning-augmented product search system for conversational shopping, using an LLM to extract attributes, compare products, filter candidates, and re-rank results.
Post-trained the model with reinforcement learning on composite relevance and engagement rewards, improving Recall@3 and task success over SFT baselines on multi-intent queries.

timeline.title: Research Intern
timeline.summary: Data, Knowledge, and Intelligence group. Focus: LLMs for tabular learning and reasoning.
highlights: Developed ForestLLM, an LLM-based approach for constructing interpretable random forests for few-shot tabular classification and regression.
Post-trained GPT, Qwen, LLaMA, and DeepSeek models for tabular question answering, improving numerical reasoning and table comprehension.

timeline.title: Applied Scientist
timeline.summary: Production ML for video recommendation and K-12 mathematical reasoning.
highlights: Developed and evaluated production ML solutions for video recommendation and K-12 mathematical reasoning.
Work spanned feature engineering, model fine-tuning, and inference optimization.

timeline.title: Research Engineer Intern
highlights: Researched uncertainty-based image-quality assessment for industrial surface-defect detection.
Explored multimodal data synthesis to augment scarce defect samples.
